title: Applied Statistics for Data Work
description: Sharpen your statistical intuition for the judgment calls data roles face every day: recognizing cognitive bias traps in data, designing experiments that avoid confounds, and choosing the right test for the right structure.
outcomes: You'll recognize survivorship, Berkson's, and sampling bias in real datasets; avoid Goodhart's Law traps in metric design; interpret logistic regression coefficients and odds ratios correctly; and know when to use a paired vs unpaired t-test.
